t: This guide is for workspace admins: the things only you can do, in one place.
In this video, you will learn how to add people, set your office address, manage storage, and set up the Work features.
On the Team page, press Add person to add someone. It uses a seat of your plan.
Seats and storage on the right show what your plan allows, and what is used.
Office address tells ShankhNaad which internet address is your office, and how long locations are kept.
On the Org page, set managers and departments, or import everyone from a spreadsheet. Approvals and stand-up blockers follow managers.
On the Files page, Free up space deletes old chat files for everyone.
In Work, set approval rules, create roles, set up stand-ups, and turn on the reception tablet.
And only admins can sound the Shankh, for real emergencies.
That completes the Running your workspace page.
Next in the Admin menu: Client workspaces.
